text: 大鲸鱼 / Big Whale 是 DSH 的动画编码伴侣，以网页浮层或支持时的 Windows 桌面窗口呈现。它把思考、工具执行、等待确认、任务完成、错误和上下文整理等会话事件转成角色反馈，并提供语音、口型同步、表情和待机动作。用户可从浮动菜单切换语言、动作与表情，也可展示米饭姿势。适合希望直观看到 DSH 会话进度并获得轻量陪伴反馈的用户；不需要额外模型或语音 API 密钥。

Big Whale is an animated DSH companion shown in a web overlay or supported Windows desktop window. It reacts to tools, approval waits, completion, errors, and compaction with voices, expressions, and idle motions. Users can change its language and appearance. No extra API key is needed.

大鲸鱼 / Big Whale 的功能「会话事件反馈」：它读取回合开始、工具调用、审批等待、错误、完成和上下文压缩等事件，并切换角色状态或发出相应反馈。
大鲸鱼 / Big Whale 的功能「网页伴侣」：DSH 客户端在 shell.overlay 注入浮层组件；组件读取伴侣状态，在网页中呈现角色界面或桌面启动入口。
大鲸鱼 / Big Whale 的功能「桌面窗口」：在支持的平台检测可用 Electron 并启动独立窗口；网页模式仍可作为回退展示。
大鲸鱼 / Big Whale 的功能「Claude Code 会话联动」：Claude Code 钩子将主会话的工具、审批和压缩事件发送给本地伴侣；/big-whale 命令显示状态与页面入口。
大鲸鱼 / Big Whale 的功能「语音播放协调」：伴侣通过 claim、heartbeat 和 release 协调语音播放租约，避免多个界面重复播放同一事件语音。

A whale-girl desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness. She keeps you company while you code, reacts to events, and picks up a giant bowl of rice when your context is compacted.

dsh-big-whale README · What she does：- Chinese, English and Japanese recorded voices with smooth lip sync.
- Mouse following, drag inertia, double-click upper-body view, eye and hair physics.
- Five idle motions and eight expressions; expressions can change while she speaks.
- Click interactions, gentle reminders to focus, event reactions and the rice pose.
- A small floating whale menu; Windows desktop mode or an in-page fallback.

dsh-big-whale README · Install：Tested with **DSH 0.2.1-rc.5** and **Node.js 22.17+**. Use your existing Web-backed DSH profile; replace `web` with its name.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-big-whale@0.6.0-rc.7
dsh web
```

If DSH is already running, restart that profile. The public prerelease channel is `dsh-big-whale@next`.

Windows desktop mode uses the optional official Electron runtime. If your package manager skipped its install script, run this inside the installed plugin directory, then restart DSH:

dsh-big-whale README · Install：```sh
node bin/desktop.mjs setup
```

The desktop pet stays visible when the DSH browser is minimized; the DSH host must remain running. Close her from the whale menu and reopen her from the whale launcher in DSH. Without an available desktop runtime, she appears inside the DSH page.

dsh-big-whale README · Use with Claude Code：Big Whale also follows your Claude Code sessions: she thinks and works with you, waits with you at a permission prompt, cheers when a turn ends and holds the giant bowl of rice while the conversation is compacted.

At a Claude Code prompt:

```text
/plugin install big-whale --marketplace Aliciawque/dsh-big-whale
```

Answer `y` to add the marketplace, then choose a scope. From a shell: `claude plugin install big-whale --marketplace Aliciawque/dsh-big-whale`.

dsh-big-whale README · Use with Claude Code：- Needs **Node.js 22.17+** on `PATH`. The plugin starts one local companion on `127.0.0.1`, shared by every session; it leaves about two minutes after the last session stops talking to it.
- On Windows she opens as the desktop window (if the Electron runtime is missing, run `node bin/desktop.mjs setup` in the installed plugin folder that `claude plugin list` shows). On macOS and Linux, run `/big-whale` for the companion page and open it in a browser.
- Only the main conversation is followed, not subagents. Tested with Claude Code 2.1.317 on Linux and Windows, including the Windows desktop window, permission prompts and compaction.

dsh-big-whale README · Controls：Drag to place her; double-click to switch full body / upper body. Open the floating whale to choose language, play an introduction, change idle motion or expression, or show the rice pose.

Idle motions: natural breathing, body twist, side-to-side lean, shy sway and mixed showcase. Expressions: normal, happy, smiling eyes, unimpressed, surprised, tears, cute and playful anger, plus event-controlled selection.

dsh-big-whale README · Controls：Below the idle-motion selector, adjust sway amplitude from 20% to 120% (default 80%). Changes take effect immediately and are saved across restarts. Natural breathing keeps its gentle baseline.

The bundled voices need no Gemini or GLM key. DSH keeps its own model and provider settings. Arbitrary new text-to-speech is not included; phone timing within aligned words is estimated.

dsh-big-whale README · Plugin markets：The repository includes a validated DSH format-1 index:

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Aliciawque/dsh-big-whale/main/market-index.json
```

In a DSH profile with Custom Plugin Market enabled, open **Plugins → Discover → Add index source** and add that URL. Community-directory discovery and official inclusion are separate processes. See [market details](https://github.com/Aliciawque/dsh-big-whale/blob/main/MARKETPLACE.md).
